test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

______ the bus stopped, the children ran out.
solution:
The correct answer is **As soon as.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **As soon as**: immediately at or shortly after the time that

 
 
• Call **as soon as** you get there.
 
 
 
• **As long as**: during the whole time that.
